test_requested_toolsets_intersected_with: test that requested toolsets are intersected with parent's enabled_toolsets to drop unauthorised tools
test_all_requested_toolsets_available_on: test that all requested toolsets pass through when available on the parent
test_no_toolsets_requested_inherits_pare: test that child inherits parent's toolsets when none are explicitly requested
test_strip_blocked_removes_delegation: test that blocked toolsets like delegation and clarify are stripped from child agent toolsets
test_empty_intersection_yields_empty_too: test that empty intersection between parent and requested toolsets yields empty child toolsets
